name: Liminal Spaces
description: Liminal spaces are an internet-born aesthetic of empty, transitional or transitionary built environments — corridors, hotel hallways, abandoned malls, stairwells — photographed without people, where the absence of human presence makes a familiar place feel uncanny, eerie, and dreamlike.

aliases.name: Weirdcore
aliases.meaning: Adjacent low-fidelity online aesthetic often paired with liminal imagery

origin: Global, networked phenomenon: imagery is sourced from buildings worldwide but circulates almost entirely online via Anglophone social-media platforms.
